events.title: Shel We
events.description: Playful, enchanting dance, full of mischief.

events.title: No One Gets Out of Here Alive
events.description: Created by The Farm — known for bold physicality, emotional directness, and irreverent theatricality — No One Gets Out of Here Alive confronts mortality into a deeply visceral experience that takes us beyond words into the nature of dying.

events.title: Are You Lonesome Tonight
events.description: Arrive in your jeans and boots, or your tuxedos and ball gowns.

events.title: Tiri: Te Araroa Woman Far Walking
events.description: An extraordinary mapping of Aotearoa New Zealand through the eyes of Te Tiriti o Waitangi Mahana.

events.title: DAYBREAKER
events.description: DAYBREAKER is a global, alcohol-free morning dance and wellness event that combines yoga, fitness, and high-energy dance to start the day with joy and community.

events.title: LEGENDS (of the Golden Arches)
events.description: A rip-roaring ride plunging two best friends into the depths of the Chinese afterlife, crossing genres, realities, and theatrical convention with infectious zest.

events.title: Scorched Earth
events.description: A murder. An interrogation. A clouded world of fantasy and fear.

events.title: This Show is a Joke!
events.description: Hold onto your cowpats! After nearly two decades of seriously silly nonsense, Matt and Rich (aka The Listies) have whipped up their most ridiculous show yet — a turbo-charged mash-up of fan favourites, slapstick, songs, and a fresh batch of brand-new, freshly hatched gags. It's a comedy extravaganza for kidults aged 4 to 4 million (dinosaurs welcome).

events.title: Generations & Dynasties: The Brady Family
events.description: A powerful afternoon of storytelling, captivating conversation, and exploring how cultural legacy is passed down the generations through music.

events.title: Generations & Dynasties: The Briscoe Sisters
events.description: A heartfelt and unforgettable afternoon of conversation, connection and soulful music.

events.title: Bleachers
events.description: Stories of loneliness and togetherness sit side by side in this new disability-led dance-theatre work by Sprung Ensemble — a collective of 10 d/Deaf and disabled artists from Bundjalung Country in Northern NSW.

events.title: The Scramble
events.description: Two men hit the mat with scrappy energy, in a charged physical duet where exertion, resistance and care collide. They twist, tussle, grapple and brace — toe to toe in a work of dance-meets-wrestling that bristles with male intimacy, contest, and connection.

events.title: Attenborough's Ocean in Concert
events.description: Sir David Attenborough’s greatest message of hope brought to life, live by Camerata.

events.title: Make, Believe, Magic: The Worlds of The Jim Henson Company
events.description: Dance your cares away! The wild and wonderful creatures of ‘The Jim Henson Company’ are coming to GOMA. QAGOMA and Brisbane Festival are thrilled to be welcoming the Fraggles exclusively to Brisbane this September.

events.title: Moorooka Feast
events.description: Join us for an evening of delicious food, great company, and meaningful connections as we gather around the table to celebrate community.

events.title: Common People Dance Eisteddfod
events.description: Seven teams. One trophy. Unlimited glory. Let the battle begin!

events.title: Pasifika Made
events.description: Where Ancestral Knowledge Meets Contemporary Pacific Arts

events.title: Moorooka Block Party
events.description: We are heading back to transform Peggs Park once again into one great big celebration of culture and community. It’s time to bring back the sounds, flavours and stories for one of the south side's most anticipated events of the year.

events.title: Manly Serenades
events.description: A feel-good night of thrills, tunes and good times by the coast.

events.title: Family Fun Day supported by Brisbane Airport
events.description: Pack your sunscreen, grab the kids and glide onto the Village Green in Verso Projects. Festival Village, South Bank for a first-class day of free family-friendly performances, entertainment and activities.

events.title: The Complete Bach Catalogue for Organ
events.description: From quiet contemplation to awe-inspiring grandeur.

events.title: RocKwiz Rocks Brisbane
events.description: Get ready Brissy, we are coming back to celebrate your fine city!

events.title: The Cruel Sea with Magic Dirt
events.description: The Cruel Sea are an ARIA-winning Australian rock institution led by Tex Perkins, known for ‘The Honeymoon Is Over’ and ‘Better Get a Lawyer’.

events.title: The Temper Trap
events.description: The Temper Trap, creators of the global hit ‘Sweet Disposition’, bring their soaring, cinematic sound to Brisbane. With over a billion streams and two ARIA #1 albums, expect a powerful live set of timeless, emotional anthems, both old and new.

events.title: Human Nature: All The Hits Live
events.description: Human Nature are one of Australia’s most successful pop vocal groups, known for flawless harmonies, slick showmanship and feel-good live energy.

events.title: ICEHOUSE
events.description: Back by popular demand, ICEHOUSE return with their legendary live energy and timeless hits like ‘Great Southern Land’, ‘Crazy’, and ‘Electric Blue’.

events.title: PNAU
events.description: ARIA Award-winning electronic duo PNAU have become one of Australia’s most influential acts, evolving from Sydney’s underground scene to global charts.

events.title: Missy Higgins
events.description: Missy Higgins, one of Australia’s most beloved voices, brings her iconic hits ‘Scar’, ‘The Special Two’, ‘Steer’ and ‘Futon Couch’ to the stage.

events.title: Lord Mayor's City Hall Concerts: David Bailey
events.description: Pipes, wheels, and reels — Buster Keaton's classic set to a live, original score.

events.title: Lord Mayor's City Hall Concerts: East of West
events.description: Storytelling spun over rich traditional rhythms.

events.description: An energising musical warm-up to the day by the river.

events.title: Piano Man
events.description: Gather round the baby grand for a wild late-night singalong.

events.title: Not a Cult*
events.description: A public spectacle of disconcerting joy.

events.title: Sunrise Ceremony: Bikki Wantimaa
events.description: Each Friday morning the Sunrise Ceremony: Bikki Wantimaa acknowledges and gives thanks to the lands on which the Festival takes place, honouring First Nations peoples who have witnessed the sunrise on these lands for thousands of years.

events.title: Dance with Tom
events.description: Join Tom for a joyful live stage experience celebrating Language from the Yugambeh Region, Culture and storytelling through movement, music and dance.

events.title: Dead Puppet Society: Sculptures & Sips Workshops
events.description: Love art and design with a side of champagne? Dive into one of Dead Puppet Society’s Sculptures & Sips workshops. Create and take home your own handmade creation, connect with like-minded makers, and work alongside Dead Puppet Society artisans in their Fabrication Workshop — where the puppets and props from their productions are imagined, designed, and brought to life.

events.title: Dead Puppet Society: Puppet Construction Workshop
events.description: Puppet Construction takes puppetry manipulation skills to the next level by allowing young people to design, craft and build their very own tabletop sized puppet.

events.title: Quandamooka Festival
events.description: Get away from the city for a vibrant celebration of Culture on Stradbroke Island.

events.title: Love Me Again Market: Morningside
events.description: Love Me Again Market is curating a special Brisbane Festival edition combining pre-loved fashion, music, community and great vibes all in one unforgettable day.

events.title: Mindful Art Mornings at Museum of Brisbane
events.description: Mindful Art Morning invites early risers to the Museum before opening hours for a gentle, guided moment of pause.

events.description: Celebrating culture, community, and confidence through dance.

events.description: A joyful journey through the rhythms and cultures of Latin America and the Caribbean.

events.description: Create your own visual language. A hands-on introduction to visual storytelling and collective making.

events.description: Come experience the joy of bellydancing.

events.title: Writing Picture Books Workshop with Jack Carty
events.description: Join Queensland-based author and singer-songwriter Jack Carty for a fun, hands-on 90-minute workshop exploring the art of writing picture books for young readers. With four books published through Scholastic Australia, international releases, and more on the way, Jack digs into the craft and creativity behind picture book writing. What makes a great idea, how to shape it into a story, and how to find your own voice.

events.title: Wake Up and Sing! with Toowong State School Signing Choir
events.description: Join the Toowong State School Signing Choir for a morning of singing and learning some basic Auslan signs. The choir consists of Auslan (Australian Sign Language) students from Years 4–6 who are Deaf, hard of hearing and hearing, and will perform a selection of popular songs to brighten your day.

events.description: Come along, raise your voice, and discover why singing together is one of life's simple pleasures.
